facility.programs_provided: Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Weekend Care,Field Trips

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Required Annual Training-Caring for children younger than 24 months: One staff observed caring for children did not have training related to SIDS/Shaken baby syndrome, and abusive head trauma.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Required Annual Training-Caring for children younger than 24 months (26 TAC §747.1305(c))

occurrences.finding: Menus Available to Licensing: A food menu portraying meals and snacks were not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Menus Available to Licensing (26 TAC §747.3113(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children records observed did not have a health statement on file, and/or available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: It was found that two 1 year olds were engaged in screen time during the walk through. This was corrected when the caregiver turned the tv off and had the assistant caregiver engage in educational circle time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children's files were missing a health statement after being enrolled over 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The outdoor play area and backyard have various items and equipment that are hazardous to children. Items that were in a shed are now accessible to children in care. Dog feces was observed on the concrete in the back patio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The smoke detector had not been tested monthly. This was corrected when it was tested and documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)

occurrences.finding: Animals at Home - No Contact with Chickens, Ducks, Reptiles: During the walkthrough, it was found that there are baby chickens in the home as a science project.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Home - No Contact with Chickens, Ducks, Reptiles (26 TAC §747.3705(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Two school age children were missing school information in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §747.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The primary caregiver did not have any of the required annual training. It was found that the primary caregiver will receive training at the end of the week.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: The 2 dogs and 1 rabbit did not have a statement of health.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: There were no vaccination records for the 2 dogs and 1 rabbit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for  Caregivers -  15 hours Annual Training: The two assistant caregivers did not have any of the required 15 clock hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for  Caregivers -  15 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal: The home had a 1A-10BC fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §747.5103)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The operational policies did not include the parent rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Animals: The operational policy does not include the mention of animals within the home. There are 2 dogs and 1 rabbit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Animals (26 TAC §747.501(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: Two children's files did not have release information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §747.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have an allergy emergency plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §747.3619)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Two children's files was missing a signed emergency medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website: The operational policies did not include how parents can access minimum standards online, the A/N hotline, and the HHSC website.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Review Licensing Rules and Reports (26 TAC §747.501(10))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: One child's file did not have any admission information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Duration of Physical Activity: The operational policies did not include the duration of physical activity outdoors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Duration of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children's files were missing a health statement after being enrolled over 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Three children's files were missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: 3 cribs did not have tight fitted sheets. 2 crib mattresses did not have any sheets and 1 crib mattress had a loose sheet that you can pinch up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §747.2309(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training: During a recent DFPS investigation, the provider did not have a personnel file for one of the caregivers and had no training records for the employee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training (26 TAC §747.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on a recent DFPS investigation, there was support for the allegation that a child was hit with a stick while in care at the daycare home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §747.2705(1))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members Used in Child/Caregiver Ratio: There were no personnel files available for those who assist with the childcare.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members Used in Child/Caregiver Ratio (26 TAC §747.903)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: I observed household cleanser stored in an unlocked kitchen cabinet that were accessible to children.  This was corrected at the time of the inspection when the provider placed a zip tie around the cabinet handles to prevent children from opening the doors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: None of the children's records had an emergency medical authorization signed by a parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The primary caregiver was not able to tell me the correct number of children in her care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child's record reviewed did not have a health statement from a physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
